questions.question_english: Which of the following is considered an exception to the concept of a performance reward?
options_english: Best Teacher Award

questions.explanation_english: Dearness allowance is a mandatory cost-of-living adjustment provided to government employees under statutory compensation rules, rather than a performance-based reward. Performance rewards specifically acknowledge exceptional professional achievements, pedagogical innovation, or discretionary effort beyond routine duties, whereas basic living allowances represent statutory, non-discretionary entitlement components of baseline employee compensation designed solely to offset inflation effects.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Dearness allowance is a mandatory cost-of-living adjustment provided to government employees under statutory compensation rules, rather than a performance-based reward.

questions.question_english: When applying Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory to compensation, how are standard baseline monetary rewards (such as basic salary) generally categorized?
options_english: As true inherent motivators that infinitely and consistently increase long-term job satisfaction across all roles.
As hygiene factors, whose absence causes dissatisfaction, but whose presence does not ensure continuous motivation.
As purely intrinsic psychological factors that directly foster personal growth, autonomy, and self-actualization.
As non-statutory extra-mural welfare measures designed exclusively to provide personal recreation for employees.
questions.explanation_english: In Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, baseline monetary compensation and working conditions function as hygiene factors. Adequate hygiene factors prevent job dissatisfaction and workplace friction, but their presence alone does not inherently generate long-term job satisfaction or deep intrinsic motivation. Sustainable motivation requires higher-order motivators, such as achievement, recognition, responsibility, autonomy, and professional growth opportunities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हर्ज़बर्ग के दो-कारक सिद्धांत में, आधारभूत मौद्रिक मुआवजा और कार्य स्थितियाँ हाइजीन कारकों के रूप में कार्य करती हैं। पर्याप्त हाइजीन कारक नौकरी के असंतोष और कार्यस्थल के तनाव को रोकते हैं, लेकिन उनकी उपस्थिति अकेले दीर्घकालिक नौकरी संतोष या गहरी अंतर्निहित प्रेरणा उत्पन्न नहीं करती। स्थायी प्रेरणा के लिए उच्च-क्रम के प्रेरक की आवश्यकता होती है, जैसे उपलब्धि, मान्यता, जिम्मेदारी, स्वायत्तता, और पेशेवर विकास के अवसर।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) As hygiene factors, whose absence causes dissatisfaction
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, baseline monetary compensation and working conditions function as hygiene factors.

questions.question_english:
According to Herzberg’s theory, if a school
     provides excellent base salaries and safe working
     conditions, but offers no recognition or career
     advancement, what will be the likely impact on
     retention?
options_english:
Teachers will be exceptionally motivated and
         retention will remain at 100% permanently.

Teachers will immediately go on strike and
         demand higher non-monetary recognitions.

Teachers won’t be dissatisfied, but may leave
         if growth opportunities exist elsewhere.

Long-term employee retention will be fully
     secured permanently across all departments.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Teachers won’t be dissatisfied, but may leave if growth opportunities exist elsewhere.' Under Herzberg’s theory, providing good salaries and working conditions satisfies hygiene needs, preventing dissatisfaction but not guaranteeing high motivation. Without intrinsic motivators like recognition, autonomy, and professional growth, teachers may feel unfulfilled and seek positions elsewhere that offer better opportunities for advancement, leading to potential turnover among ambitious staff.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। हर्ज़बर्ग के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, अच्छे वेतन और कार्य परिस्थितियाँ असंतोष को रोकती हैं, लेकिन उच्च प्रेरणा की गारंटी नहीं देतीं। मान्यता, स्वायत्तता और पेशेवर विकास जैसे आंतरिक प्रेरक के बिना, शिक्षक असंतुष्ट नहीं होंगे, लेकिन वे बेहतर विकास के अवसरों की तलाश में अन्य स्थानों पर जा सकते हैं, जिससे संभावित रूप से कर्मचारियों की टर्नओवर हो सकती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Teachers won’t be dissatisfied, but may leave if growth opportunities exist elsewhere.
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Providing good salaries and working conditions satisfies hygiene needs, preventing dissatisfaction but not guaranteeing high motivation.

questions.question_english: Identify the correct statement regarding the impact of rewards on teacher retention.
options_english: Total rewards, combining fair pay, supportive culture, and recognition, drive retention.
Only exceptionally high financial compensation guarantees long-term employee retention.
Non-monetary rewards have absolutely zero impact on long-term teacher retention rates.
Retention is purely dependent on the geographical location of the school institution.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is that total rewards, which include fair pay, a supportive culture, and recognition, are essential for driving teacher retention. Teacher retention relies on a comprehensive rewards strategy that integrates fair base pay, supportive work environments, professional growth opportunities, and meaningful recognition. Solely relying on financial compensation is often inadequate; non-monetary factors, such as a positive workplace culture and strong administrative support, are crucial for retaining high-performing educators over the long term.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कुल पुरस्कार, जिसमें उचित वेतन, सहायक संस्कृति और मान्यता शामिल हैं, शिक्षक बनाए रखने में मदद करते हैं। शिक्षक बनाए रखने की प्रक्रिया एक समग्र पुरस्कार रणनीति पर निर्भर करती है, जो उचित वेतन, सहायक कार्य वातावरण, पेशेवर विकास और महत्वपूर्ण मान्यता को एकीकृत करती है। केवल वित्तीय मुआवजे पर निर्भर रहना अक्सर अपर्याप्त होता है; गैर-निधीय कारक, सकारात्मक कार्यस्थल संस्कृति और मजबूत प्रशासनिक समर्थन, उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वाले शिक्षकों को दीर्घकालिक बनाए रखने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Total rewards, combining fair pay, supportive culture, and recognition, drive retention.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Teacher retention relies on a total rewards strategy that integrates fair base pay, supportive work environments, professional growth, and meaningful recognition.

Consider the following two statements: one is labeled
        as Assertion (A) and the other as
        Reason (R).
        Assertion (A): According to Equity Theory, if a
        teacher perceives that they are working harder
        (higher input) than a colleague but receiving the
        same or lesser recognition (lower outcome), they
        will experience tension.
        Reason (R): This perceived state of ‘under-reward
        inequity’ often leads the teacher to reduce their
        effort or become demotivated to restore equity.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

A is true but R is false

questions.explanation_english: Equity Theory explains that when a teacher invests higher effort than a colleague but receives equal or lower recognition, perceived under-reward inequity causes tension. To relieve this psychological stress, the teacher may lower inputs, such as reducing discretionary effort, unless leadership restores perceived fairness through transparent, equitable recognition.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। यह सिद्धांत बताता है कि जब एक शिक्षक अपने सहयोगी की तुलना में अधिक प्रयास करता है लेकिन समान या कम मान्यता प्राप्त करता है, तो उसे तनाव का अनुभव होता है। इस मनोवैज्ञानिक तनाव को कम करने के लिए, शिक्षक अपने प्रयासों को कम कर सकता है, जब तक कि नेतृत्व पारदर्शी और समान मान्यता के माध्यम से perceived fairness को बहाल नहीं करता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

questions.question_english: According to reinforcement theories of motivation, what is the direct cause-and-effect relationship of administering a timely reward following a teacher’s exceptional pedagogical intervention?
options_english: It reduces the teacher’s intrinsic motivation to teach.
It causes immediate resentment among all other staff members, reducing overall school efficiency.
It neutralizes the need for future administrative supervision.
It increases the probability that the exceptional teaching behavior will be repeated.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that it increases the probability that the exceptional teaching behavior will be repeated. Under Skinnerian reinforcement theories of motivation, administering positive reinforcement immediately after a target behavior strengthens the psychological link between the action and its positive outcome. Timely recognition or rewarding of exceptional pedagogical interventions increases the likelihood that the teacher will repeat that effective behavior, while simultaneously signaling institutional priorities and performance expectations to the broader school faculty.
